obligations.summary: The Commission shall have exclusive powers to supervise and enforce Chapter V obligations on providers of general-purpose AI models, entrusting implementation to the AI Office.
exceptions: Division of competences between Member States and the Union based on the Treaties is preserved.

obligations.summary: Market surveillance authorities may request the Commission to exercise its enforcement powers under this Section where necessary and proportionate to assist with their tasks under the Regulation.
exceptions: Request is subject to Article 75(3) without prejudice.
Request must be necessary and proportionate.
